children: D-Wave Quantum announced a government-backed financing package anchored by an Other Transaction Agreement under the U.S. CHIPS and Science Act worth up to $100 million, alongside a planned Securities Issuance Agreement to issue 7,095,721 common shares at $14.093 per share to the U.S. Department of Commerce. The CHIPS award supports advanced microelectronics R&D for quantum technologies, with an initial $53.55 million tranche available shortly after the Sept. 4, 2026 award date and further payments tied to technical milestones. The share issuance includes transfer limits linked to funds drawn, limited voting while held by a U.S. government entity, and resale registration rights. Together, these agreements are intended to accelerate D-Wave's development and scaling of superconducting quantum systems.
